reviews.text: Russell's plucking was a complete failure, we have never had such a bad plucking for our dogs. The work was only partially done, the hair was spiky. We had to negotiate with the place to finish the work the next day. We agreed to use scissors for the stomach hair, but scissors had also been used on the face. The guy clearly did not know how to pluck properly, in that case it would not be worth selling the service.
The washing of the mouse went really well, and it came out so clean that even all the odors were removed. Thank you!

We brought our long-haired Maine Coon cat to be groomed at Kuonola, Lauttasaari. The long fur gets tangled really easily so we decided to shave it shorter. Thank you Geraldine! You did a very good job and very fast! We will definitely come back with Gunnar😊 …
I am really happy with my groomer who washes and grooms my dog's nails.
Clean facilities, nice staff and my poodle turned out exactly how I wanted. They also take my dog's fear of having his paws trimmed into consideration. I recommend the place!
Thanks again Erika! Skillful, precise and gentle grooming of Isla's doodle coat ❤️

Ludmila from Lauttasaari is a great person. She seems to be in control of even the smallest things, so you don't lose control. Great experience for me as a host, maybe Ebba will behave better next time...at Ludmila's school.
Thanks to her.

The dog's nail clipping was handled very unprofessionally. The dog suffered and screamed during the clipping, and I had to stop it myself after the procedure had lasted a couple of minutes. After the clipping, I noticed that the dog's nails had been cut until they were bleeding. I was still charged 17€ for this and the dog will be traumatized for life.

Horrible experience! One of the worst services ever! I booked the de-shedding service which should only include washing and brushing of the undercoat. When I dropped off my dog there, the groomer offered me an additional service that was described to me as hygienic “cleaning” around the anal area. Trimming was never requested, discussed or agreed upon.

However, when I picked him up, the outer coat had clearly been cut with scissors all throughout and his back was trimmed extensively (Pomerianian style). Even one side of his whiskers had been trimmed. At the same time, the deshedding was not done, barely any brushing in fact. When he came back, after just one brush, it was completely full of loose undercoat easily and the texture of the undercoat was still the same in most areas.

My dog is a Mittelspitz registered for two upcoming important dog shows. Trimming like that is completely unacceptable for his bread! It is a fault. The mittelspitz specialty dog show in only two weeks on 24th of May, which is only once a year. I have invested a lot of time, money and energy into training and preparing for the show for an entire year, the registration fees, the training money, the transport .... Now it’s all ruined, I have to cancel everything!!! Horrendous!!

Update: While I understand that mishaps can happen by junior groomers, I was shocked to see the response of customer service from even management. Although, they offered a refund of the de-shedding service that I still paid for, there was never an apology or accountability for trimming the dog without my consent. They completely denied using scissors on the coat despite the photos and evidence and placed the complete blame on me for not mentioning the dog show for a service that should have been only washing and brushing.

I also want to add that before the appointment, I had reached out by phone to customer service to clarify that no trimming is performed in the washing package I selected and also specifically mentioned in the booking beforehand that I use English, this was no language mistake. I took him to a different service provider previously and it was a much better experience; I am never going back there ever! I will still pursue this through the appropriate channels for the loss of fees.

Previously very happy with the great employee Karoliina
Today another employee cut the dog's nails and the dog left really stressed.
Now that was good service and a good trim, thank you.
Kkss fur plucking is done flawlessly here.
Warm service. Ransu was in skilled hands🩷 …

I just had my puppy's nails trimmed and the experience was pretty horrible. We entered the store and the leash was immediately grabbed from my hand. I tried to tell the person, as he dragged the dog along the floor, that it was a puppy that we should try to contact first. The answer was that we know it's a puppy and they grabbed the dog by the armpit. Most of the nails had been trimmed well, although even those were uneven. The dog was really stressed the whole way home, probably the last time in that store.

We took our two long-haired cats to Kuonola Lauttasaari for grooming and were really pleased. The staff (Geraldine) was knowledgeable and professional. The fur was trimmed neatly and the end result is really beautiful. Excellent service - we will definitely come again!
Karo groomed our dog (Coton de Tulear) really beautifully and neatly - and exactly according to our wishes.
There was a lot of tangles and the fur was cut short because of that. The groomer did a great job, and the cat was calm after the service. The employees were really friendly.
It's always nice to visit Kuonola in Lauttasaari. Erika has done a great job with our miniature poodle, and has turned our difficult poodle into a model groomer. So a big recommendation for Erika!

The trim is absolutely a draw. Out of 10 trims for our Yorkie, maybe 6 were successful and the quality was very uneven. The last trim was absolutely terrible and uneven and the instructions were not even followed. For the price, these cannot be recommended for small dogs.
Great, almost always the dog is trimmed perfectly, no complaints.
Thank you, Geraldine, for the wonderful haircut and your gentle care for our dog! This was our first visit, and we will definitely come back again!
Nice and professional service!

The Lapphund went to the undercoat wash. They say there were tangles under the stomach so they had to remove them. The dog was quite upset after the treatment and when I got home I noticed that his stomach was full of these marks. The breed must not be very familiar to the groomer, judging by how he came back after 1.5 hours.
The place was more than wonderful and clean and the workers were kind, especially Geraldina🥰, she treated my cat with love. I will definitely come back to visit the place. <3 …
